description: This file defines the Indexer class for managing indexed storage operations, including indexing, deindexing, reading, writing, and migrating indices, within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Indexer
classes.description: A generic class for managing indexed storage items, supporting operations like add, remove, read, write, and migration of indices.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the index list from storage.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the index.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Adds a key to the index if it does not already exist.

methods.name: deindex
methods.description: Removes a key from the index.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all indexed items from storage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads an item by key from storage.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes an item to storage with a key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from storage by key.

methods.name: readMulti
methods.description: Reads multiple items by their keys.

methods.name: migrateIndices
methods.description: Migrates old indices to the current format.
